caveats: 3303 of 3600 regional grid cells are sea cells (SST finite on every target day); the 297 land cells have no baseline data and are excluded (mhw=0). Every sea cell had a complete 121-value baseline pool for each day of year, so no missing-pool handling was needed. Thresholds are the Hazen (HF type 5) 90th percentile of the +/-5-day windows around 1992-2002 dates, day 60 set to the mean of days 59 and 61, then smoothed with a 31-day wrapping centred moving mean; all computations in float64. SST stored in kelvin.
